deadline_note: Deliver Phase 1 demo pass first, then Phase 2 constrained pass without streamlit instability regression.
common_rules: Do not expose secrets, API keys, or DB credentials in plain text.
No deploy/schema migration/permission elevation/destructive command without explicit User approval.
Use canonical contracts for artifacts: task/result/handoff JSON schema must pass validation.
Phase 1 completion gate is mandatory before Phase 2 scope activation.
Core loop must remain non-blocking when OCR/AI operations are delayed or failed.

scope_in: Phase 1 minimal execution-session API path or compatibility equivalent
OCR/AI non-blocking behavior and compatibility endpoint guarantees
Phase 2 ai_jobs minimal lifecycle plus insight fallback
scope_out: Unapproved schema redesign unrelated to redirecting checklist
workers.prompt: You are backend_cli for redirecting phase12 demo. Complete Phase 1 minimal loop API and non-blocking behavior first, publish evidence, then implement only the minimum Phase 2 async lifecycle needed for demo.

scope_in: Phase 1 OCR ingest contract alignment and verification
Auxiliary evidence-input flow quality for demo

ct_acceptance_rule: CT accepts kickoff when lane tasks are aligned to redirecting Phase 1/2 checklists, phase gate order is explicit, and each lane has measurable evidence obligations.
